# Winifred Tolley

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls  <sub>[v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c11 P4](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0004)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c10 P22](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0022)</sub>; Miss Winifred  <sub>[v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c10 P22](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0022), [v4 c11 P0](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

She lives in a bright emerald house about half a mile along the road near Seven Gulls.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P35](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0035), [v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037)_

## Personality

She possesses a sharp tongue alongside a deeply compassionate heart, always arriving in the gentlest manner to assist anyone in trouble. Though she holds a persistent disdain for men and Methodists, she never speaks a cruel word about another woman. She is a loyal friend who holds tightly to those she cares about, even when they seem distant.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040)_

## Traits

- Sharp-tongued  <sub>[v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040)</sub>
- Compassionate  <sub>[v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040)</sub>
- Dislikes men  <sub>[v4 c6 P38](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0038), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c11 P0](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0000)</sub>
- Dislikes Methodists  <sub>[v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040)</sub>

## Abilities

- Exceptional hospitality and cooking  <sub>[v4 c10 P33](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0033), [v4 c10 P35](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0035)</sub>

## History

Winifred Tolley resides in a bright emerald house in Seven Gulls, where she maintains a reputation for having a sharp tongue toward men but an exceptionally kind heart toward those in need. During her youth, she was courted by many but chose to remain unmarried. She maintained a steadfast friendship with Lorna Vane, standing by her despite Lorna's distant and aloof nature following the tragic return of her husband, Rufus Vane.

After Dr. Hugh Carrow and his wife Nell moved to Seven Gulls, Winifred visited them and hosted them for a lavish state tea at her home. During an autumn visit with Nell, she recounted the full history of Lorna Vane's tragedy and shared news regarding local events.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P35](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0035), [v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c10 P24](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0024), [v4 c10 P33](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0033), [v4 c11 P0](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0000), [v4 c11 P11](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0011), [v4 c11 P13](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0013), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)_

## Background by volume

- Had many suitors in her youth and could have married anyone she chose  <sub>[v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040)</sub>
- Had a cousin named Flora at the Glen whose husband died by suicide  <sub>[v4 c11 P2](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0002)</sub>

## Affiliations

- Presbyterian Church — Member  <sub>[v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037)</sub>

## Relationships

### Lorna Vane

- Friend of — She considers herself Lorna's closest friend and holds onto her tightly despite Lorna's distant nature.  <sub>[v4 c11 P13](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0013), [v4 c11 P30](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0030)</sub>

### Nell Harcourt

- Friend of — She visits Nell at her home and confides in her regarding local history and Lorna's past.  <sub>[v4 c10 P24](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0024), [v4 c10 P33](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0033), [v4 c11 P0](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0000), [v4 c11 P12](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0012)</sub>

### Hugh Carrow

- Comrade of — She hosts Dr. Hugh Carrow and Nell for tea at her residence.  <sub>[v4 c10 P22](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0022), [v4 c10 P33](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0033)</sub>

### Captain Saul Garrick

- Friend of — She speaks fondly of Captain Saul, who notes her sharp tongue and kind nature.  <sub>[v4 c6 P40](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0040), [v4 c6 P41](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0041)</sub>
